title: AuditKIT: A Unified Evaluation Spine for Benchmarking, Judging, and Comparing Large Language Models and Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22511v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating language models and agents requires combining benchmark accuracy, judge-based assessment, runtime performance, tool-use behavior, and retrieval quality. Differences in interfaces, metric semantics, and trace formats complicate these comparisons and can hide failures in agentic workflows. We present AuditKIT, a source-available evaluation library that records these measurements in one result representation, with direction-aware metric contracts, configuration fingerprints, and extensible metrics and backends. For agents, it provides turn-aware tool-call matching, separates parallel from sequential execution, and distinguishes verified task outcomes from trajectory-level diagnostics. Missing or unobservable evidence is marked unscored rather than counted as failure. translated_title: AuditKIT：一个用于大语言模型与智能体系统基准测试、评判与比较的统一评估主干
translated_abstract: 评估语言模型和智能体需要综合基准测试准确率、基于评判模型的评估、运行时性能、工具使用行为以及检索质量等多方面指标。接口、指标语义和轨迹格式的差异使这些比较变得复杂，并可能掩盖智能体工作流中的失败。我们提出了AuditKIT，一个源码可用的评估库，它将这些测量统一记录在单一的结果表示中，具备方向感知的指标契约、配置指纹以及可扩展的指标和后端。针对智能体，它提供回合感知的工具调用匹配，区分并行与顺序执行，并将经过验证的任务结果与轨迹级诊断区分开来。缺失或不可观察的证据会被标记为“未评分”，而不是被计为失败。针对检索增强生成（RAG），它结合了排序检索指标、评判式的依据性评估以及确定性的证据检查。七个案例研究涵盖模型（比较）……
tldr: AuditKIT是一个统一的评估框架，将基准测试、评判评估、运行时性能、工具使用和检索质量整合到单一结果表示中，解决了大语言模型与智能体系统评估中接口和指标语义不一致的问题。
en_tdlr: AuditKIT is a unified evaluation framework that consolidates benchmarking, judge-based assessment, runtime performance, tool-use behavior, and retrieval quality into a single result representation, addressing interface and metric semantic inconsistencies in evaluating large language models and agentic systems.
